brief:
Palestinian farmers remain unable to access their olive groves in occupied territory, blocked by Israeli settlers and military forces, Al Jazeera English reported. The obstruction prevents the annual harvest, a critical economic activity for Palestinian communities.

The blockade affects Palestinian livelihoods during the harvest season, when farmers typically collect olives for oil production and sale. No timeline for access restoration was indicated.
dek: Palestinian farmers are still being blocked from accessing their olive groves by Israeli settlers and the military…
title: Israeli settlers and military block Palestinian olive harvest
